meta.scope: NBA-first fan merch + local businesses; can a merchant act on a day-T prediction-market signal to capture T+1..T+21 demand
meta.units: lead_time_days_* are calendar days (business-day figures converted ~x1.4); fractional = hours/24
meta.labels: [est] = analyst estimate; [secondary] = non-primary or vendor-marketing source

archetypes.name: Print-on-demand fan store (Printful / Printify / Gelato)
archetypes.description: Zero-inventory Shopify store; each order printed (DTG/DTF) and shipped by the POD provider. Typically unlicensed 'city/vibe' designs.

actions.action: Create design and publish synced Shopify listing
actions.cost_notes: Design labor only; mockups auto-generated. Printful markets 'time-to-market from 6 months to 1 hour or less' [2nd: vendor marketing]. Typical/slow include design time [est].

actions.action: POD production after order (fulfillment)
actions.cost_notes: Printful: 2-5 business days (>97% ship <=5 bd, >50% <=3 bd); Printify: most orders ship within 2-7 bd. Calendar-day conversion [est]. Peak season adds 2-5 days [2nd].

actions.action: US shipping after production
actions.cost_notes: Printful US standard 3-4 bd, express 1-3 bd. Customer-paid shipping typically ~$4 first tee [2nd].

actions.action: End-to-end order -> customer doorstep
actions.cost_notes: Printify Express: 2-3 bd total on select US products; typical total 7-12 days, worst 14-21 [2nd]. Gelato claims US delivery 3-5 days [vendor marketing].

actions.action: Launch new Meta ad (creative + ad set) and pass review
actions.cost_notes: Meta: review 'typically completed within 24 hours'; may take longer. Requires pre-built creative.

actions.action: Meta ad set exits learning phase (stable CPA)
actions.cost_notes: ~50 optimization events per ad set within 7 days => daily budget ~ 7x target CPA (e.g. $15 CPA -> ~$107/day). Budget edits >~20% (or targeting/creative/bid changes) can reset learning; 'Learning Limited' if 50/7d unreachable. Slow value = 2 resets [est].

actions.action: Google Ads smart-bidding calibration after change
actions.cost_notes: ~50 conversion events or ~3 conversion cycles; allow >=24h for ad review [2nd for 7-day norm].

actions.action: Send email campaign to existing list (Klaviyo)
actions.cost_notes: Minutes for send; SendGrid infrastructure reports median delivery 1.9 s. Copy/design time dominates [est].

actions.action: Send SMS campaign to existing subscribers (Klaviyo)
actions.cost_notes: Throughput 10 msg/s (toll-free/10DLC) => 100k msgs ~2.8 h; short code 100 msg/s => ~17 min. One-time setup must precede season: toll-free verification 7-10 business days, short code 8-12 weeks.

archetypes.overstock_notes: Not applicable: made to order, no unsold units. Downside limited to design time and ad spend. Gross margin excludes shipping and ads; Printful Growth/Business plans lower unit cost to $9.05/$8.45; Printify Gildan 5000 ~$7-9.
archetypes.notes: Can capture orders same day; physical delivery lags 3-12 days, which matters if fans want the item before a specific game.

archetypes.name: In-house DTF/DTG print shop on Shopify holding blanks
archetypes.description: Merchant holds blank tees (Gildan/Bella+Canvas from SanMar, S&S Activewear/alphabroder) and presses DTF transfers or prints DTG in-house; ships own orders.

actions.action: Restock blanks from US wholesaler (SanMar / S&S / alphabroder)
actions.cost_notes: SanMar: 9 DCs, same-day ship if ordered before cutoff (UPS Ground 4pm local; next-day air 1-4pm). S&S: 14 warehouses, 1-2 day delivery to most of US. alphabroder (S&S-owned since Oct 2024): 10 DCs, next-day to 96% of US population. Gildan 5000 ~$3.06-3.41/unit at $100-1,500 orders. Slow = color/size stockouts [est].

actions.action: Order DTF transfers / gang sheets (e.g. Ninja Transfers)
actions.cost_notes: Ninja: order before 3pm ET for same-day ship / Next Day Air (from ~$25.55-$28.11); 40% of orders ship next day; usually same/next bd production, up to 2-3 bd; standard ground 5-7 bd (free >$75). DTF list price from ~$0.03/sq in with up to 65% volume discount => ~$1.50-3.60 per 11x11 front [est].

actions.action: Press DTF transfers onto blanks (in-house)
actions.cost_notes: 30-60 s press per shirt (~1-2 min all-in) => ~60-120 shirts/hour per press+operator [est from Printify]. Labor ~$0.50-1.00/shirt [est].

actions.action: Print DTG in-house
actions.cost_notes: DTG 2-3 min/shirt print + pretreat/cure; production units e.g. Epson F3070 ~65 shirts/h, Kornit Storm II ~60/h [2nd].

actions.action: Ship to customer (UPS Ground / USPS)
actions.cost_notes: Carrier ground transit [est].

actions.action: Artwork proof and approval
actions.cost_notes: Clock does not start until art approved and paid; approval delays are the most common slip [est for days].

actions.action: Standard screen-print production
actions.cost_notes: Standard 7-10 business days after approval (some shops 10 bd standard; some 15-30 bd). Calendar conversion [est].

actions.action: Rush screen-print production
actions.cost_notes: Rush fee as % of order: 1 bd +60%, 2-3 bd +50%, 4-5 bd +25%, 6-9 bd +10% (Blue Chip; 2pm CT cutoff). Rush often requires higher minimums [2nd].

actions.action: Freight from printer to merchant/3PL and receiving
actions.cost_notes: Ground 1-3 days [est]; 3PL receiving: Flexport direct inbound 1-3 calendar days, crossdock 3-11 days; ShipBob 'hours or a few days'.

actions.action: Open pre-orders on Shopify to measure demand before committing
actions.cost_notes: Shopify Selling Plan API supports pre-orders/deposits via apps; requires Shopify Payments or PayPal Express.

actions.cost_notes: Unverified estimate; depends on account and allocation. During hot markets, allocation goes to Fanatics/major retailers first [est].

archetypes.name: Restaurant / sports bar near the arena
archetypes.description: Local on-premise business whose demand spikes on home playoff game nights (and watch parties for away games).

actions.action: Reorder food from broadline distributor (US Foods / Sysco)
actions.cost_notes: US Foods Pronto: 8pm cutoff for next-day delivery, 6 days/week, no minimum (charges <10 cases), 76 metro areas. Sysco: branch-specific cutoffs (e.g. Hawaii 4pm day-before); orders editable until cutoff in Sysco Shop. Accounts without daily routes wait for next scheduled delivery day [est].

actions.action: Add/adjust staff shifts - independent venue not covered by fair-workweek law
actions.cost_notes: Most independent bars/restaurants fall below coverage thresholds; constraint is staff availability [est].

actions.action: Add/adjust staff shifts - covered chain (NYC fast food; Chicago/Seattle/Philadelphia large restaurant chains)
actions.cost_notes: Penalty-free only with 14 days' notice. NYC fast food premiums per change: $10 (add/shift, <14d), $20 (reduce, <14d), $15 (add, <7d), $45 (reduce, <7d), $75 (reduce <24h). Chicago/Seattle: +1 hour pay per change. Coverage: Chicago restaurants 30+ locations & 250+ employees; Seattle full-service 40+ locations & 500+ employees; Philadelphia 250+ employees & 30+ locations; LA City ordinance retail-only.

actions.action: Game-day promotion via social / email / SMS
actions.cost_notes: Hours [est].

archetypes.overstock_notes: Estimates: food+beverage cost ~30-35% of sales (industry rule of thumb, not sourced here). Salvage: perishables low, shelf-stable beer/liquor high; blended ~30% [est]. Uplift evidence: near-arena restaurant spend +15-84% on Canadiens home playoff games 2026 (NHL analog); Toronto bar transactions +76% at 11pm after Raptors ECF G6 (2019). Away games/Sundays flat or negative.
archetypes.notes: Signal most useful as probability of a HOME game on a given date (Games 5-7 are 'if necessary').

archetypes.name: Hotel / short-term rental near the arena
archetypes.description: Room-night inventory is fixed and perishable; the lever is price, minimum stay and restrictions set before bookings arrive.

actions.action: Reprice via hotel RMS (IDeaS / Duetto)
actions.cost_notes: Continuous/real-time pricing between floor and ceiling; slow = once-daily optimization cadence [est].

actions.action: Reprice STR via PriceLabs (or similar)
actions.cost_notes: Default nightly sync (1-3x/day with add-on); Real-Time Sync up to 24 updates/day, min 60 min between triggers.

actions.action: Set min-stay / close-out restrictions
actions.cost_notes: Same channel-manager mechanics as price [est].

actions.action: Housekeeping/front-desk staffing (Chicago hotels covered by Fair Workweek)
actions.cost_notes: Chicago covers hotels with >100 employees globally: 14-day notice, 1h predictability pay per change.

archetypes.overstock_notes: Unsold room-nights perish (0% salvage); the cost of a late signal is underpricing, not overstock. Evidence: Indianapolis 2025 Finals Game 4 ADR only +2% vs 30 days prior ('missed opportunity'); OKC hotel search +45% vs 22-month average; Milwaukee 2021 Finals rooms $400+/night.
archetypes.notes: Acts in minutes; value of the signal is moving rates before the booking wave.
